content_html:
Rubber Hose

Industrial-grade reinforced rubber hoses engineered for safe, reliable fluid and material transfer across manufacturing, agricultural, mining, and oil & gas operations. PT Misuba Guna Indonesia supplies high-performance rubber hoses built with specialized tube compounds (EPDM, NBR, SBR, Neoprene, Food-Grade White Rubber) reinforced with high-density textile plies or helical steel wire for suction and discharge service.

Supplied as bulk hose rolls or fully tested custom assemblies fitted with crimped or clamped couplings (Camlock, Flanged, NPT/BSP thread, Bauer).

Custom Engineering Consultation & Ordering Guide

Tell us your hose application details—internal diameter (ID), working pressure, suction or discharge requirement, media (air, water, oil, cement powder, steam), and preferred end fittings (e.g. Camlock Type C/E, ANSI Flanges). PT Misuba Guna Indonesia provides quick custom assembly, pressure testing, and delivery.
